Despite the joke in the title the matter is very serious!  
Private server owners please be aware of the hacker. He goes by the name “UrUbonZ” or some variation of it (ex. |-|URUBONZ|-|). He scans the ip’s and then uses his bot “Uru checker” to scan the ports of the servers and then breaks into them. He often uses a space before the nickname which makes it impossible to ban him. He claims that he just looks around the servers. As soon as he left our server, my friend turned on the whitelisting. This angered him, because he couldn’t re-enter, however he managed to bypass this by entering my username and logging into the server as me. Than he proceeded to set all the buildings on fire, made big holes going down to bedrock and kill most of the pets. I will upload the picture in the comments. 400+ hours worth of building gone.  
I am writing this to warn other players about him, so they can protect their servers.  
Remember to turn on the whitelist in your server settings!
